messages:
claire: Hi all 
 I have a quick change: daycare opening moved up and I4m returning earlier than planned. Hoping to come back 80% FTE starting 2027-03-01 for 6 weeks. Questions: do I need to refile anything for benefits/proration? Also I requested a lactation pump last month but I moved countries temporarily  can the pump be shipped internationally or is there a reimbursement path?
people-ops: Congrats, Claire! :tada: Short answers: 1) Submit the Phased Return form selecting 80% and the new start date; that kicks payroll and benefits proration. 2) For equipment, we typically ship domestically; if you're abroad we can either reimburse an approved purchase or ship to a US address and forward. Please note shipping internationally may have customs/tax implications.
michelle: Payroll note: use code PT80-2027 on the form so we can handle proration and subsidy. If we need to process retro pay for any overlap, include dates and the payroll team will review.
claire: Thanks. I do need a small retro for the week I was on unpaid leave but worked one evening sprint. Will file the timesheet, but wanted to confirm policy on retro pay for partial days during leave.
michelle: Retro pay for work performed during an approved leave needs manager sign-off and payroll approval. Attach manager approval to the timesheet and we'll run it on the next off-cycle payroll if needed.
oscar: I can cover code reviews during Claire4s first two weeks back. Claire, which days will you be online?
claire: Tue/Thu remote, Wed in-office. Block Mon/Fri for childcare handoffs.
people-ops: Lactation pump: if you need the exact model we provide, shipping internationally requires compliance signoff. Alternative: purchase locally and submit receipts with code PUMP-INT for reimbursement. Reimbursements processed as taxable reimbursements; submit within 30 days.
legal: Also flag: importing medical devices may require local documentation. If you're abroad, DM us country and we4ll confirm. Reimbursement avoids import issues.
claire: I'm in Spain for 4 weeks starting 2027-02-20. I4ll DM legal on country docs. Prefer to buy locally if easier.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit the Phased Return form within 5 business days to guarantee subsidy proration before your return date.
people-ops: Next steps checklist for Claire: 1) submit Phased Return (PT80-2027) 2) attach manager sign-off for retro hours 3) DM legal about Spain import rules OR upload pump receipt for PUMP-INT reimbursement 4) oscar to confirm review coverage. We'll update when done.
claire: Submitted form and attached manager sign-off; DM sent to legal re: Spain. Thanks everyone :heart:
